name: html-css-to-image
description: Let AI agents capture live website screenshots, render HTML/CSS, and populate reusable templates as images or PDFs - without managing a browser.

interface.shortDescription: Turn websites and HTML/CSS into images or PDFs
interface.longDescription:
Turn a simple request into polished images, website screenshots, and PDFs—without leaving your AI assistant. HTML/CSS to Image combines flexible browser-based rendering with natural-language control, helping developers, marketers, and content teams create consistent visual assets faster.

Use it to:

- Create social graphics, product images, reports, certificates, and other branded assets from HTML and CSS
- Capture website screenshots for previews, documentation, testing, and visual QA
- Produce personalized images at scale with reusable, versioned templates and dynamic variables
- Generate batches across responsive dimensions, time zones, color schemes, and other variations in one workflow
- Export to PNG, JPG, WebP, or PDF with precise control over viewport size, device scale, selectors, render delays, and more
- Keep your rendering pipeline under your control with organization-level resources:
  - Deliver rendered files directly to your own Amazon S3 or S3-compatible storage
  - Route renders through HTTP or HTTPS proxies you configure
  - Automate dynamic Open Graph images using one stable image URL pattern, with page metadata driving up-to-date social previews—even for static sites
